title: campioni/2: roles and times of the files of a series
description: One entry per file, in the order of injection: the one model of the roles and times of the Data view and of mzFinder (mzlab-core campioni). Proposed from the names by `proponi` (times never confirmed), migrated from the old places by `da_legacy`, checked by `valida`, read by the TP path through `per_tp`. Canonical JSON: keys in alphabetical order, so the same metadata give the same bytes and the same SHA-256.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw file: the key (the name can change); empty when not known yet

tipo_bianco.description: optional, only for a blank: every blank is subtracted the same way

tempo.description: the time as written or confirmed, in unita_tempo

tempo_min.description: derived from tempo and unita_tempo: the only time used in the computations; 0 for a t0

tempo_confermato.description: false for a time proposed from the name: never used before the user confirms it

serie.description: the experiment the file belongs to; empty = the only one, or shared by all

istd.description: the file is an internal standard

composto.description: for an infusion: formula or name of the parent
